clue.text: With wear, it produces a hold-up on the line

definitions.text: With wear, it produces a hold-up on the line

parts.words: With wear, it produces a hold-up on the line
parts.note: reads like a traffic or railway delay caused by worn equipment, but describes a small wooden gripper that keeps garments (wear) aloft on a washing line

explanation.surface: Worn-out equipment is causing a delay on the railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hold-up' suggests a delay and 'line' a railway; in fact the line is a washing line, and the item holds up wear, that is clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden or plastic clip pins laundry to a washing line so it stays suspended while drying.

clue.text: Uncontrolled trouble in the plant

parts.note: something uncontrolled is loose, running free
trouble or conflict is strife

explanation.surface: Unchecked unrest is spreading among the crops.
explanation.definitionFit: Purple and yellow varieties of this flowering herb grow wild beside British rivers and ponds.

clue.text: First-class spinner with ability to deceive batsmen

parts.note: a spinning top is a toy spinner
in cricket, flight is the loop a slow bowler gives the ball to trick the batsman about where it will land

explanation.surface: A top-quality spin bowler can fool the batsmen with the ball's trajectory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spinner' looks like a cricket spin bowler, which the surface encourages; here it is the child's toy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of the highest rank or standard is described as being in the leading division.

clue.text: Took part in event and established a record

definitions.meaning: someone who signed up for and joined a competition
made an entry in a register or ledger, logging something formally

explanation.definitionFit: To go in for a race is one sense; to write details into a book or log is the other.

clue.text: Appeal for funds as one's hard up — that's out of order

indicators.note: letters that are out of order are jumbled, so the words before are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of one's, apostrophe dropped
taken as written
taken as written
the letters of that's, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Asking for money because you're broke is improper behaviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of order' reads as a moral judgement but signals the anagram of ONES HARD UP THATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Collecting donations by circulating headwear is an idiom for soliciting contributions.

clue.text: Musical instruments suit rag composition

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters are assembled afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Stringed players adapt themselves to a ragtime piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' suggests a musical work, fitting rag; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Six-stringed fretted instruments are plucked or strummed.

clue.text: Black bird in wood, possibly

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A dark bird perches in a forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wood' looks like a forest; in the game of bowls the balls are called woods.
explanation.definitionFit: In lawn bowls each ball is traditionally called a wood, so a wood is one example.

clue.text: Such repute would be non-U in America

definitions.text: Such repute would be non-U in America

parts.words: Such repute would be non-U in America
parts.note: being 'in bad' something means having a poor reputation; the word for it is spelt in American English without its U, so it is non-U there

explanation.surface: This sort of reputation would be considered vulgar in the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Non-U' is old British slang for not upper-class; here it literally means lacking the letter U, as in the American spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Reputation is a person's standing, as in being held 'in good smell' with someone, the idiom meaning favour.

clue.text: Line one added to article, being flexible

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A line and a single item joined to a written piece make it supple.
explanation.definitionFit: Supple and agile, bending easily without breaking.

clue.text: Takes part but finishes without medal finally

indicators.note: without means the letter chosen from medal is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: finishes means completes

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of medal

explanation.surface: An athlete enters and crosses the line, though wins no medal in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: COMPLETES loses L, the last letter of 'medal'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who contests an event is a participant in it.

clue.text: Tenor that comes from overseas

definitions.meaning: tenor here is the gist or meaning of something said

explanation.definitionFit: Significance or meaning is one sense; foreign goods brought into a country is the other.

clue.text: He handles money and supplies an account

definitions.meaning: one who recounts a story, a narrator

explanation.definitionFit: A bank cashier counts out money; a narrator tells a tale.

clue.text: Cross most of the tram lines

indicators.note: most of means the word tram is used without its final letter

parts.note: lines of poetry are verse

explanation.surface: Someone is annoyed by most of the tramlines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like angry; it is the verb, to go across.
explanation.definitionFit: To go across or pass over a stretch of ground or water.

clue.text: Gambling in casino let up, possibly

indicators.note: possibly means the letters given could form something else, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: In the casino the betting may have eased off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' signals the anagram of CASINO LET UP.
explanation.definitionFit: Risky investment or betting on uncertain outcomes is a form of wagering.

clue.text: Kind of party that's in decline without trustworthy leader

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the word for decline surrounds the letter

parts.note: to decline or droop is to sag

indicators.note: leader points to the opening letter of trustworthy

explanation.surface: A political party slumps because it lacks a reliable leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it is the old sense 'outside': SAG goes round T.
explanation.definitionFit: A men-only celebration before a wedding is a kind of party.

clue.text: Well below the surface of the ocean — note depth

parts.note: relating to the ocean depths is deep-sea
te is a note in tonic sol-fa

explanation.surface: Deep in the sea, a reading is noted of how far down it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Firmly rooted or ingrained, lying far beneath the exterior.

clue.text: Perfume ingredient in mixture girls left out after cautionary signal

indicators.note: after means the rearranged letters come after the signal word

parts.note: amber is the warning light on traffic signals

indicators.note: a mixture stirs things together, so the letters are reordered
left out means the letter L, for left, is removed from girls

explanation.surface: A scent component is mixed with girls left aside after a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: GIRLS loses L ('left out') to give GIRS, which is rearranged ('mixture') to GRIS.
explanation.definitionFit: A waxy substance from sperm whales has long been used to fix scents in fine fragrances.

clue.text: One lacking animation, in time shows spirit?

indicators.note: in means the pieces before it are placed inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
I is the Roman numeral one
something without movement is still

explanation.surface: A lifeless person seen at a given time displays great inner energy?
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' looks like vitality, but here it is distilled alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcoholic liquor such as whisky is produced by distilling, so it is an example of such a product.

clue.text: Spill, possibly, from a vessel

definitions.meaning: a spill is a thin strip of wood or paper used to light a fire or pipe
a flat-bottomed barge used to unload ships

explanation.definitionFit: Something that kindles a flame is one sense; a cargo barge is the other.

clue.text: In which kings have only a few men left

definitions.text: In which kings have only a few men left

parts.words: In which kings have only a few men left
parts.note: sounds like a story of monarchs with dwindling armies, but describes the final phase of a chess game when few pieces remain

explanation.surface: Monarchs find their forces depleted to a handful of soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: The last stage of a chess match, when most pieces have been captured.

clue.text: Save to secure ring for engagement

indicators.note: to secure means to hold fast, so the word for save is placed around the letter

parts.note: save in the sense of except means but
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A man saves up to buy a ring for his engagement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Save' means 'except', BUT; 'engagement' is a fight, not a betrothal.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxing match or a fight is an engagement between opponents.

clue.text: Youth providing something needed for driving range, perhaps

parts.note: in golf a tee holds the ball for a drive

indicators.note: perhaps means the word range could appear in another form, so it is rearranged

explanation.surface: A young person supplies equipment for the golf practice ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driving range' reads as one golfing phrase; it splits into TEE for driving and the anagram of RANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: An adolescent aged thirteen to nineteen is a young person.

clue.text: Get slimmer and lighter

definitions.meaning: to narrow gradually towards one end
a long thin wick or candle used to light fires or lamps

explanation.definitionFit: Narrowing gradually is one sense; a slender candle for kindling is the other.

clue.text: Swift animal died after dash

indicators.note: after means the letter for died follows the word for dash

parts.note: dash meaning verve or flair is élan

explanation.surface: A fast creature died following a sprint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dash' looks like a sprint but means flair, ELAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A large African antelope that can run quickly.

clue.text: Departs from town or city in Africa

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for departs, as in timetables
urban means of or from a town

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a town or a city on the African continent.
explanation.definitionFit: A major port in South Africa on the Indian Ocean coast.

clue.text: Tree planted ahead of time in earth, say

indicators.note: planted ahead of means the tree is put before the letter for time

parts.note: a plane is a tree

explanation.surface: A tree is set in the soil early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'earth' looks like soil to plant a tree in; it is our world, an example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Our world is one of the bodies orbiting the Sun.

clue.text: Dauntless girl getting father help

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
aid means help

explanation.surface: A brave girl gets assistance from her dad.
explanation.definitionFit: Without fear, brave and bold.

clue.text: Newlywed heading off for trip

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: a newlywed woman is a bride

explanation.surface: A newly married woman sets off on her honeymoon journey.
explanation.walkthrough: BRIDE loses its first letter, B ('heading off').
explanation.definitionFit: A journey on horseback or in a vehicle is a short outing.

clue.text: Changing one's habits and making amends

definitions.meaning: putting on clothes again, habits being garments

explanation.definitionFit: Putting clothes back on is one sense; setting right a wrong is the other.
